output.one_liner: WooCommerce is a free, open-source ecommerce platform for WordPress that provides a REST API to connect stores with external systems.

auth.notes: REST API uses consumer key and consumer secret generated per WordPress user. WordPress methods support basic auth.

evidence.snippet: The WooCommerce REST API uses a key system to control access. Each set of keys is linked to a WordPress user.
WOOCOMMERCE_CONSUMER_KEY: WooCommerce REST API consumer key WOOCOMMERCE_CONSUMER_SECRET: WooCommerce REST API consumer secret

access.notes: WooCommerce is free and open-source. Store owners generate API keys in their own WordPress admin dashboard.

evidence.snippet: WooCommerce is the free, Open Source ecommerce platform for WordPress.
Free to download and use. Unlimited products, orders, and APIs.
The WooCommerce REST API connects your store to external systems and services.
WooCommerce REST API Docs — the complete technical reference for all available endpoints.
It provides comprehensive tools for managing all aspects of products, orders, customers, shipping, taxes, discounts, store configuration.
Webhooks configured to use the legacy REST API also stop working unless you install this plugin.
Jan 23, 2026 Call for Testing: WooCommerce MCP Beta
A WooCommerce (MCP) Model Context Protocol server for WooCommerce integration, compatible with Windows, macOS, and Linux.

buildability.rationale: Free self-serve credentials, documented REST API with broad coverage; toolkit could be built today.

overview_evidence.snippet: The WooCommerce REST API connects your store to external systems and services.
WooCommerce is the free, Open Source ecommerce platform for WordPress.
